iface lo inet loopback
   address 127.0.0.1
   netmask 255.255.0.0
   scope host
   post-up ip addr del 127.0.0.1/8 dev lo
   pre-down ip addr add 127.0.0.1/8 dev lo

# The management network interface
auto eth0
iface eth0 inet dhcp
    metric 202
iface eth0 inet6 dhcp
    up sysctl net.ipv6.conf.eth0.accept_ra=1
    down sysctl net.ipv6.conf.eth0.accept_ra=0
#
source /etc/network/interfaces.d/*
#

---interfaces.d---
== /etc/network/interfaces.d/* ==
---docker0route---
240.127.1.0/24 dev docker0 proto kernel scope link src 240.127.1.1 linkdown
